title: We All Have a "Serious Work" AI and a "Just Vibing" AI. When Did That Happen?
why_read: A casual, anecdotal post about personal habits of choosing between different AI chat tools, offering minimal technical depth or generalizable insight.
analysis: This is an informal, conversational blog post about the author's personal habit of using different AI models for different tasks, such as Claude Opus for hard problems and Gemini for routine work. It includes casual asides and GIFs and reads more like a diary entry than a technical analysis, with no benchmarks, data, or rigorous comparison behind the claims about model hallucination rates. It may resonate with readers who have similar habits but doesn't offer new technical information.
